history.period: Original temple pre-1963; new temple post-Bhakra Dam (1960s)
history.summary: The Laxmi Narayan Temple was an integral part of old Bilaspur town in the princely state of Kahlur. After the Bhakra Dam submerged old Bilaspur under Gobind Sagar Lake, the idols — including the Ranganath idol — were moved to the new town, and the temple was re-established near the bus stand (Diara Sector, Excise Colony). Built in Shikhar Shaily style in white marble with five golden shikharas; also known locally as the Rangnath / Khan Mukheshwar Mahadev temple. Remains of the old temple are reportedly visible in summer when reservoir levels fall.

name: Shri Laxmi Narayan Mandir
town_description: Bilaspur is a district headquarters town on the Sutlej in Himachal Pradesh; the old town was submerged by Gobind Sagar Lake after the Bhakra Dam, and the modern town sits beside the reservoir.

travel.road: Near Bilaspur bus stand on NH-21; easily accessible by car and bus
